textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 maths · Fun with Symmetry · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Rani folds a paper twice and cuts a small corner. When she opens it, the cut appears in all four parts of the paper.

beats.en: Rani folds a paper twice and cuts a small corner. When she opens it, the cut appears in all four parts of the paper. Every fold makes the cut repeat once more, because each fold doubles the number of parts.
beats.speakEn: Rani folds a paper twice and cuts a small corner. When she opens it, the cut appears in all four parts of the paper. Every fold makes the cut repeat once more, because each fold doubles the number of parts.

beats.en: A shape is symmetrical if we can fold it along a line so that the two parts fit exactly on each other. That fold line is its line of symmetry. Some shapes have more than one line.
beats.speakEn: A shape is symmetrical if we can fold it along a line so that the two parts fit exactly on each other. That fold line is its line of symmetry. Some shapes have more than one line.

textbookBox.concept: A mirror shows the reflection of whatever stands next to it. The line where the mirror stands is called the mirror line or line of reflection.
